name: CRYSTAL RULE (PILOT)
description: A pilot of Crystal-style sprite discipline on three lines (oak, flytrap, sunflower): a shared #181818 outline and #f8f8f8 highlight white, each species owning just two colours with flat, bold two-tone shading, sports that swap only those two, and a per-species entrance animation. Compare with the base art in the Art Lab.
author: Verdant Reach art pilot (agents 2-4), generated by tools/art/pilot_crystal/
credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/pilot_crystal/*.py. Pokemon Crystal's battle sprites were studied for principles only (palette discipline, flat bold shading, white highlights, per-species intros); no Nintendo/Game Freak sprite was copied, traced or imported. Plant reference photos as credited in each species bundle.
